sources.title: Is there a trick to using Wave Frame GL's?
sources.author: PalaceOfStones (comment), with other participant reports
sources.classification: Historical firsthand community report; not Bungie documentation or a controlled current test
summary: Comment describes grenade ricochets off walls, objects and combatants before ground contact. A backward bounce can therefore send the resulting ground wave toward the shooter.
Comment says waves stop at walls and can travel on slopes or stairs; other participants report failures on uneven surfaces and small terrain features.
sources.boundary: No current direct/entity collision guarantee, restitution, maximum bounce count, floor-normal threshold, gap behavior, slab rule or slope angle is established. Accounts disagree about terrain reliability. The same comment’s claim that Blast Radius is useless is superseded by O4 and must not be imported.

sources.title: Grenade Launcher breakdown
sources.author: lamogamo
sources.classification: Historical firsthand community testing of another wave launcher, Martyr’s Retribution
summary: The author distinguishes impact/blast contributions from the separate wave contribution for Martyr’s Retribution.
Comments describe terrain stopping or redirecting the wave and connect its heading to grenade movement at impact.
sources.boundary: Historical comparator, not testing of selected Deafening Whisper or Dimensional Hypotrochoid. Damage numbers, ratios, exact dimensions and modern bounce behavior are not transferable. Linked images were not independently opened or validated.
